title: The Tide Bell of the Salt Orchard
description: At the first low tide, the orchard tender rings the bronze bell. Its note carries over the salt pools as the pear trees catch the sunrise.
alt: A gray-haired woman in an embroidered red coat pulls the rope of a green bronze bell beneath crystalline pears above terraced salt pools at sunrise.
pairing: A first-low-tide festival × a pear orchard grown in coastal salt flats
